name: character
kind: 2D cut-out puppet made from a picture (flat, seen from the front)
notes: sway (side to side, in the picture plane) reads best on a flat puppet; lean and twist move it out of the plane, keep them small

description.body_plan: A flat, front-facing, pear-shaped plush character with curly hair and blue mitten-like arms but no separate legs or neck.

bone_regions.root: base of the body and overall position
bone_regions.upper: upper body, heart patch, and attached arms

substitutions.arms: Suggest arm gestures by swaying the upper body, carrying the attached blue arms with it.
substitutions.legs: Use root lift for hops and squash for landings instead of steps.
substitutions.hips: Sway the root and lower belly from side to side.
substitutions.head: Tilt the face and hair with gentle upper and top-bone sway.
substitutions.torso: Bend the lower and upper body in a soft, continuous curve.

constraints: Keep the base above the floor except during squash on landing.
Avoid implying independently articulated arms or nonexistent legs.
Favor in-plane sway; keep lean and twist small so the flat puppet stays readable.
Keep motion within the rig limits.
